description:
Shield AI is seeking a Software Engineer II to build software for automated production test stands that functionally test X-BAT avionics and aircraft electrical assemblies. You will develop Python applications and reusable components for test sequencing, equipment control, device communication, measurement collection, and traceable test results.



You will independently deliver defined software components and test capabilities within an established architecture, from implementation and automated testing through hardware integration and controlled release. You will collaborate with electrical engineers and production users to resolve interface details and improve diagnostics. Senior engineers will provide architectural guidance and review for unfamiliar or higher-risk changes.



What you'll do

* Design and implement defined test-software components, including test sequences, instrument interfaces, device communication, and result reporting, within established framework conventions.

* Translate documented hardware interfaces and approved test requirements into software behavior, confirming unclear assumptions with electrical and embedded-software engineers.

* Build unit and integration tests using simulated devices and representative hardware; exercise communication failures, invalid measurements, interrupted sequences, and recovery behavior.

* Integrate software with fixtures, instrumentation, and units under test, verifying units, scaling, timestamps, and result handling against agreed references and procedures.

* Record software versions, hardware configurations, device identifiers, and measurement context needed to reproduce and investigate test results.

* Release assigned components through established configuration-control and deployment workflows, including regression evidence, setup documentation, and recovery instructions.

* Diagnose failures in your components and participate in hardware/software investigations; use logs and targeted experiments to separate software defects from equipment, fixture, or device issues.

* Improve maintainability and reduce recurring failures within your scope, coordinating software changes with electrical engineers, manufacturing users, and other software owners.



Required qualifications

* Proficiency in Python, including modular software design, exception handling, debugging, and automated testing.

* Experience independently delivering a defined software component from requirements through integration and release.

* Experience integrating software with a device, instrument, embedded system, or comparable external interface, including handling communication errors and unexpected responses.

* Experience using Git, code review, automated tests, and repeatable build or deployment workflows.

* Ability to investigate failures across software and external interfaces using logs, documentation, and controlled experiments.

* Ability to clarify requirements with technical partners and document interfaces, configuration dependencies, and operating behavior.



Preferred qualifications

* Experience developing software for automated hardware test, manufacturing equipment, robotics, or other hardware-integrated systems.

* Familiarity with Linux, Bash, networking, or instrument-control libraries.

* Experience with C or C++, embedded-device interfaces, register-level access, or FPGA-enabled hardware.

* Experience with programmable power supplies, electronic loads, data-acquisition equipment, digital I/O, or custom fixtures.

* Experience with test-result databases, serial-number tracking, configuration management, or continuous-integration pipelines.
